html:
The 16th TSAE International Conference & 24th TSAE National Conference (TSAE 2023), organized by School of Engineering and Innovation, Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-ok (RMUTTO) and Thai Society Agricultural Engineering (TSAE), is the premier forum for the presentation of new technologies, innovation and research results in the fields regarding the agricultural and food industries. The conference will take place from July 26 – 27, 2023 at the Oakwood Hotel & Residence Sriracha, Chonburi, Thailand and will bring together leading researchers, engineers and scientists in the domain of interest from around the world.

For more details, click here.
